title: Ядовитые растения
originalDescription:
Colorful mushrooms or lovely flowering plants release a cloud of spores or pollen when disturbed, causing creatures to fall into a magical slumber.

- **EV:** 2 per 10 x 10 field
- **Stamina:** 3 per square
- **Size:** One or more squares

> 🌀 **Deactivate**
>
> Each square of plants must be individually destroyed.

> ❕ **Activate**
>
> A creature starts their turn in the area of the toxic plants, or enters a square of toxic plants without [shifting](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting).
>
> **Effect:** The **Sleep Spores** ability.

> ❗️ **Sleep Spores**
>
> | **Magic, Melee, Strike** |      **Free [triggered action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action)** |
> |--------------------------|-------------------------------:|
> | **📏 Melee 0**           | **🎯 The triggering creature** |
>
> **Trigger:** A creature starts their turn in the area of the toxic plants, or enters a square of toxic plants without [shifting](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting).
>
> **Power Roll + 2:**
>
> - **≤11:** M < 0 [dazed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/dazed) ([save](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.general/saving-throw) ends)
> - **12-16:** M < 1 [dazed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/dazed) ([save](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.general/saving-throw) ends)
> - **17+:** M < 2 [dazed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/dazed) ([save](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.general/saving-throw) ends)
>
> **Effect:** While [dazed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/dazed) this way, a target who starts their turn in the area of the toxic plants falls [prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone) and can't stand.

> ⭐️ **Upgrades**
>
> **Poisonous Spores (+2 EV)** Any creature [dazed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/dazed) by this hazard takes 1d6 poison damage at the start of each of their turns.
>
> **Carnivorous Plants (+2 EV)** The plants are carnivorous and attempt to slowly digest any creature who falls among them. Any creature who starts their turn [prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone) in the area takes 4 acid damage.
